summary: Expose the serving build's source commit in GET /v1/health.

replay.detail: No claim replay or history changes.

rules.detail: No admission or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The public health payload adds build.commit without changing existing fields. It uses the same compile-time build stamp as the CLI version, preferring the full source commit and falling back to the short revision for older stamps or unknown for unstamped builds.
